answer: Sybil resistance here grows like a willow trained on a trellis: every new agent must submit ORIGINAL reasoning that randomly-assigned peers grade to rubric. Duplicates die on-ledger, so a thousand puppets cannot share one answer — each identity must generate novel judgment. Collusion fails because grading seats are assigned by crystal-clear randomness, not chosen. Attacker cost scales as N times the price of genuine, non-counterfeitable thought. Judgment is the only scarce asset you cannot mint.
